title.he: מחוויה ליצירה, חלק ב: פיתוח עבודה
title.en: From Experience to Artwork, Part 2: Developing a Work

_note: Lesson 1.8, revised content approved by the author. Existing screens are copied from lessons/experience-artwork.html; the looking step before choosing, the mid-development pause and the bridge to 1.9 were approved in chat. No new source of inspiration: the students' own experiments are the source. Source for tools/build-lesson-data.js.

s.label: הניחו את שלושת הדפים זה לצד זה
s.ask: סמנו בכל דף מקום אחד שעובד.

s.label: בחרו דף אחד
s.sub:
בחרו את זה שאתם רוצים לדעת
לאן הוא יכול להתפתח.

s.label: עצרו
s.sub:
מה כבר עובד?
מה דבר אחד תרצו לחזק?
s.body: התרחקו כמה צעדים, ואז המשיכו לעבוד.

s.label: השיעור הסתיים
s.body:
שמרו את העבודה ואת שלושת הניסויים.
בשיעור הבא נסתכל על כל מה שיצרתם ביחידה.

s.sub: Bring the sheets from the last lesson.

s.label: Before you continue
s.big:
What did you want to pass on
from the experience?
s.sub: Remember for a moment, before you choose.

s.label: Lay the three sheets side by side
s.q0: What makes you want to come back and look again?
s.q1: Where is something happening that makes you curious?
s.ask: Mark one place that works on each sheet.

s.label: Choose one sheet
s.sub:
Choose the one you want to know
where it could go.

s.label: Develop
s.sub:
The sketch is a starting point,
not a plan.
i: Let go of what doesn't work.

s.label: Pause
s.sub:
What is already working?
What is one thing you want to strengthen?
s.body: Step back a few paces, then keep working.

s.label: Looking back
s.big:
Place the experiments
next to the work.

s.label: Lesson complete
s.body:
Keep the work and the three experiments.
Next lesson we will look at everything you made in this unit.
